dedupe_keys.name: productionnetworksimulator firm level supply chain shock propagation inoue and todo

description: Open code that simulates how shocks to firms spread through a supply chain network. The GitHub README says the code is based on the adaptive regional input-output model of Hallegatte (2008) and Henriet and Hallegatte (2008), modified by Inoue and Todo (2017) to simulate actual firm-level production networks, as in their study of negative shocks on supply chain data. It is C++ source with a Windows executable and toy input files (transaction table, final demand, initial production and firm affiliation), and options for shock scenarios and output statistics, all free to download from the repository. Coverage is any production network the user supplies. Caveats: the licence is not stated on the page read, and real firm data must come from the user. For simulation it propagates direct damage from earthquakes or floods to firms along supplier-customer links, estimating indirect production losses. A related catalogue record is the Acclimate supply chain loss propagation model.
